MMDD dropped from nodes; day header carries it. Time only, HH:mm (setting).
Same-display-string pages get the high-granularity format HH:mm:ss (setting).
Inactive nodes become quaternary ticks; only the active node is a filled dot.
Day words on a day's first gutter only; placeholder title never rendered.
Gauge removed from every gutter. TTL lives on the active rail node only.
Same-minute inserts render HH:mm:ss, so each header is distinct: 13:00:04 / :17 / :41.
Title repeated as first body line
Gutter title hidden while the page's first line is on screen.
Title derives from the first non-fence line: 'if Onetime::Utils…', not 'ruby'.
Intentional minimap, not a texture block. No change.
Time display rule: a time shown without its date is HH:mm (never HHmm); HH:mm:ss when the HH:mm string would collide. Both formats are settings.
